title: Agent roles cannot call the session tools, and a lint keeps it so
why: Agent roles could call the claude-code-remote session tools (send, interrupt, create sessions), which belong to orchestrators; a stray interrupt_session from a record-writer on 2026-11-01 is one case.
note: Deny mcp__claude-code-remote__* through disallowedTools in agents/*.md for reviewer, test-author, builder, record-writer, designer, design-reviewer, Explore and Plan, plus a lint check that keeps it. Finding B (round-2 reviewer on Sonnet) is no defect. Topic agent-roles. Absorbs step explore-no-create-session (coordinator, 17:32 CST): an Explore agent in lane replay-profile-parts made a stray session through create_session; that incident is this lane's red test. 18:19 CST Nov 7: #1674 (agents-no-remote-tools: the guard refuses an agent's outward claude-code-remote calls, all 20 tools) is with runner 8, stacked on #1566. Sighting (coordinator, 04:26 CST Nov 8): a fix-check reviewer in lane session_013NEJL2xaiFZSCyk6vknwcT (map-names-any-file) called create_session. The #1331 fix-check reviewer's create_session at 04:05 CST left an empty session, now archived. Lane session_013NEJKzc39M5wFtru1uU5u4 (#1674) keeps this step; lane map-names-any-file dropped its follow-up (coordinator, 04:28 CST Nov 8). Two more sightings (lane idle-lane-steps-unknown, 04:52 CST Nov 8): a haiku reviewer of #1861 round 1 and a haiku record-writer of #1889's records each made a stray create_session call with no parameters; the auto-mode classifier denied both, and nothing was created.
